d:

What makes our work different is that we do not approach biotechnology as a standalone product business. We work at the process level, understanding plant conditions, production bottlenecks, raw material variations and operational constraints before developing solutions tailored to each application.

From fermentation challenges in ethanol production to recovery optimisation in sugar processing, our teams work closely with manufacturers to solve problems that directly affect productivity, consistency and profitability.

Backed by in-house R&D, application expertise and decades of industrial experience, The Catalysts Group continues to develop spec solutions across:

- Industrial Enzymes

- Fermentation Technologies
- Distillery & Ethanol Process Optimisation
- Sugar Process Improvement Solutions

- Grain Processing Technologies

Today, we are proud to be trusted by 1135+ customers worldwide while continuing to build biotechnology solutions designed for real industrial environments, where performance is measured not in presentations but in output, recovery and operational reliability.

Purpose-built AI agents automate critical workflows across trade compliance, classification, prospecting, and supplier discovery.

name: TBO.COM
d:
TBO is a global platform that aims to simplify all buying and selling travel needs of 1 million+ Travel Partners across the world. The proprietary technology platform aims to simplify the demands of the complex world of global travel by seamlessly connecting the highly distributed travel buyers and travel suppliers at scale.
 
The TBO journey began in 2006 with a simple goal - to address the evolving needs of travel buyers and suppliers, and what started off as a single product air ticketing company, has today become the leading B2A (Business to Agents) travel portal across the Americas, UK & Europe, Africa, Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific. 
 
In 2023, TBO expanded its global presence by acquiring Jumbonline S.L.U., enhancing its hotel inventory and strengthening partnerships across key international markets. Notably, TBO was publicly listed on the NSE and BSE in India on 15th May 2024, marking a significant step in its journey.
 
Today, TBO’s product range spans air, hotels, rail, holiday packages, car rentals, transfers, sightseeing, cruise, and cargo. Apart from these products, our proprietary platform relies heavily on AI/ML to offer unique listings and products, meeting specific requirements put forth by customers, thus increasing conversions.

In 2025, TBO further scaled its premium offering with the acquisition of Classic Vacations USA, adding a strong portfolio of luxury travel experiences to its global ecosystem.
 
TBO’s approach has always been technology-first and we continue to invest in new innovations and offerings to make travel easy and simple. TBO’s travel APIs are serving large travel ecosystems across the world, while the modular architecture of the platform enables new travel products and expansion into new geographies.

d:
RAYY is India's experience booking platform, making it effortless to book sports courts, fitness sessions, hobby classes, kids' activities, and entertainment experiences.

RAYY replaces that friction with instant, verified bookings—all in one place.

Today, RAYY connects people to 1,000+ verified venue partners, helping them discover and book experiences in 5 minutes instead of spending hours coordinating plans.

For users, it's the fastest way to discover and book experiences nearby. For venue partners and instructors, it's a smarter way to fill empty slots, reach more customers, and grow beyond word of mouth.

Starting in Gurugram, we're building the booking infrastructure for India's experience economy—one city at a time.

1,000+ venues. 5-minute bookings. ₹9 first trial.

Our belief is simple: If it's real and it's nearby, it should be one tap away.

But then it happened.
Happiness was just not enough.
One day, we received a brief and we ditched it. We asked: instead of a happy end result, what if we created something that pleasantly shocked you, and consequently, wowed your audience? What if we made you a brand that wasn't just happy, but happily remembered?
That's what Enki Studio is all about. Imagination. Innovation. And a healthy dose of rebellion. We tell visual stories that become topics of conversation, whether it's design, videos, brand identities, or packaging. If you can see it, we'll show you how to tell a story with it.

Refnic also designs and establishes metallurgical refining units — both pilot-scale and commercial-scale — enabling seamless transition from laboratory validation to full industrial deployment.

Refnic’s expertise spans extraction and recovery of base, critical, rare earth, and precious metals from diverse feedstocks including lithium-ion batteries, black mass, industrial sludge, e-waste, spent catalysts, rare earth magnets, and primary metal ores. The company supports recovery of lithium, cobalt, nickel, manganese, copper, aluminum, gold, silver, palladium, and other high-value metals through optimized and scalable process engineering.

In the e-waste domain, Refnic develops solutions for precious metal recovery from PCBs and electronic scrap, integrating mechanical separation, refining systems, and downstream purification processes to maximize yield and economic return.

With a strong focus on engineering precision, sustainability, and circular economy principles, Refnic partners with recyclers, mining companies, and energy-sector stakeholders to build next-generation metal recovery and refining infrastructure — driving resource efficiency, environmental responsibility, and long-term industrial growth.

100+ facility filters including women’s washrooms, disabled access, digital payment options, hygiene standards, and photos of facilities.

Digital Mobility Services: FASTag, RSA, insurance, GPS tracking, EV charging stations, and Raksha QR (our in-house road safety initiative).

What Makes Us Unique:
First platform to show verified washroom photos and feedback for highway stops.

First to map accident-prone zones using verified data for preventive safety.

First to enable mobile payments and food pre-ordering along highways.

Built-in IoT feedback system for hygiene and safety at public stops.

We’re building the future of highway mobility—where travel is not just about reaching your destination, but having the tools and trust to enjoy the journey.

The Oracle AI Data Platform enables organizations to build, deploy, and govern AI agents and applications on top of private, secure, and distributed enterprise data. This enables organizations to operationalize AI without compromising data security or control.
